questions.text: It is easier to sustain tacit collusion in an infinitely repeated game if _______.

answers.text: a firm charges a single price to all of its customers
the present value of cheating is less than the present value of collusion

feedback: Correct! Tacit collusion is easier to sustain when the present value of cheating is less than the present value of collusion.

questions.text: Tacit collusion occurs when firms accomplish collusive outcomes indirectly by learning from experience how each other will behave in a market.
feedback: Correct! Tacit collusion occurs when firms learn from experience how other firms will behave in a market.

questions.text: A sequential-move game is a game in which each player makes decisions without knowledge of the other players' decisions.
feedback: Correct! That is the definition of a simultaneous-move game. In a sequential-move game, one player moves after observing the other player's move.

questions.text: Which of the following is not an element of an extensive-form game?

answers.text: All of the above are elements of an extensive-form game

feedback: Correct! Payoffs, strategies, and the sequence of player decisions are all elements of an extensive-form game.

questions.text: To solve sequential games, one should use a logical reasoning process known as backward induction.
feedback: Correct! To solve sequential games, one should use a logical reasoning process known as backward induction, whereby players rule out non-rational actions at the end of the game, to reason what the appropriate action should be at the beginning of the game.
